motions.label: Learned terrain · +10° cross slope
motions.description: The learned actor drives across +10° cross slope, stops, and balances. This example passes at both physics timesteps. 5/13 courses in this development screen pass at both timesteps.
motions.limit_text: 10/26 rollouts pass every route, exposure, balance and motor/mechanism gate. A terrain-trained actor commands all four motors from IMU, encoders and explicit speed/yaw commands at 100 Hz. No teacher intervention or pose correction in replay. Fixed heightfield and rigid 120 mm tires; one known course seed, not randomized off-road or hardware qualification. Internal self-contact, printed strength, loose ground and tire compliance remain unqualified.
